Additional comments:

questions.answer: I don't really remember, but I think it was easy. However, it was very complicated to chose courses

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Not much. The student administrator did not really answer on emails

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not at all. I did not have all my classes once we arrived and it got fixed after several weeks into the semester

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Keep on fighting, it will be fine at last but it is a long and frustrating process
